case_name: S3-C Twain ref + Banff text + pot text
title: S3-C Twain ref + Banff text + pot text

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the MAN; he must look exactly like this, same face, hair, moustache and suit, in colour. He stands on a foreground rock ledge, seen from the side, looking out over this place: A vivid turquoise lake fills the lower half, darkening to blue beneath shadows at the far left shore. A towering wall of jagged gray mountains spans the background, with sheer, horizontally layered cliffs, pale scree slopes, and narrow patches of snow in gullies and beneath summits. Dense dark-green conifers cover the curving right shoreline and climb the hillside, extending toward the distant center. Small docks and colorful boats sit along the lower right bank. Rough, angular gray rock slabs form a foreground ledge across the bottom, beside a tall slender evergreen on the left. Bright daytime sunlight illuminates the lake and right-hand forest beneath a blue sky streaked with soft white clouds. Beside his feet on the ledge sits this pot: A squat, thick-walled stone pot, roughly one-and-a-half times wider than tall, with a broad circular mouth, rounded rim, nearly straight sides and flat base. The surface is weathered grey-brown with pale beige edges and darker recesses; the interior is rough and undecorated. Beneath the rim runs a narrow band of deeply cut alternating triangles. The broad middle band is divided by vertical toothed borders into rectangular panels filled with angular triangles and intersecting diagonal grooves. The front-right panel contains a large four-lobed motif outlined by several concentric grooves. A second triangular border circles the bottom above a plain foot edge. One short, solid, flattened rectangular lug projects horizontally from the upper right side; no open spout. He is the only person.

must_haves: The man is recognisably the man in the attached portrait.
The place matches the Banff description (turquoise lake, jagged grey mountain wall with snow patches, dark conifers on the right shore, rock ledge in the foreground).
The pot matches the pot description.
